name: puzzle
description: Puzzle is a full-service accounting system that connects to banking, card, payroll and payment providers for accurate, current books.

interface.longDescription:
Accurate books. AI speed. Puzzle is a full-service accounting system for startups and small businesses. Connect banking, credit card, payroll and payment providers—including Stripe, Brex, Mercury, Ramp, Deel and Gusto—so your books stay accurate and current in one system.

Ask about cash, burn and runway; pull a balance sheet, income statement or cash flow statement; review and categorize transactions; work through bills and invoices; reconcile accounts; and manage revenue recognition and month-end close. Puzzle's AI agents handle the repetitive accounting work while you stay in control.

The connection starts read-only. You choose which companies it can see, and changes to the books require write access and your confirmation. Available actions depend on your Puzzle plan, role, enabled features and connected financial providers. You can revoke access any time in Puzzle under Settings → Connected apps.
capabilities: Financial reports: balance sheet, income statement, cash flow
Bills, AP aging and vendor spend
Invoices, AR aging and customer payments
